title: Speculative enquiry: junior civil drafter
relocation_line: I will relocate to Townsville for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am writing to ask whether Langtree Consulting has room for a junior civil drafter in its Townsville civil design team. Your careers page describes drafting for property drainage assessments and the civil design of earthworks and roads under a senior mentor, which is the work my studies prepared me for.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, reviewing structural and architectural drawings, carrying out inspections and quality checks, and preparing site and progress reports. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
